info.name: Money Sync — current WizStore API requests
info.description: Direct requests to the same WizStore endpoints used by Money Sync. Set wizstore_api_key as a secret current value in a Postman environment (from your WIZSTORE_API_KEY); no API key is stored in this collection. Search returns WizStore’s raw response before Money Sync filters and sorts it. Basket uses one barcode and one city per request; Money Sync makes one basket request per selected city, and repeats it when saving or refreshing an offer. Barcode and city are independent of search, so set barcode to a result you want to inspect. Requests consume WizStore quota.

request.description: Same GET /search request as searchWizProducts. Change query in collection variables. The backend retains results with a valid 6–14 digit barcode and a name; it exposes code, name, manufacturer and min_effective.

exec: pm.test('Response is JSON and contains data', () => { pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('data'); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Search results are an array', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.results).to.be.an('array')); }

item.name: 2. Find store offers for a product in one city

request.description: Same POST /basket request as getWizOffers. Set barcode and city in collection variables. The backend checks the matched barcode and retains complete stores with a valid effective_total. This is also the upstream request made when saving or refreshing a selected offer; responses are capped by WizStore.

exec: pm.test('Response is JSON and contains data', () => { pm.response.to.be.json; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('data'); });
